Secondbrain sample upload document.

This text file is the `upload_document` tool's integration-test payload. Its
base64 encoding sits next to it (`sample-document.txt.b64`), byte-for-byte
what the tool receives, so a test can compare what lands in the upload
directory against the original.

It mentions semantic search, embedding vectors, and Qdrant so a real-CLI
ingest of the uploaded file has something to chunk.
